entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: An undead naga translator in Silumgar's court, once a power-seeking mortal, who secretly gathers poisons in the hole where her heart was, waiting to kill the dragon.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The dragonlord whose court Sidisi serves, who rules the Sultai region for millennia and breathes poison.

entities.name: Jhinu
entities.description: A human who sent an envoy to bribe Sidisi; Sidisi remembers him from her previous life.

entities.name: Envoy from Marang
entities.description: A wealthy human envoy who brings tribute from Marang, tries to bribe Sidisi, and attempts to poison Silumgar before being thrown in a pit.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragonlord whose protectorate's fortresses and regents have fallen to the envoy's people.

entities.name: Naga
entities.description: Scaled people who cannot produce the dragons' precise language and whom Sidisi hopes will rule these lands.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: Undead beings kept in a pit beneath Silumgar's court, feeding on those thrown in.

entities.name: Silumgar's court
entities.description: The dragon's treasure-filled throne room and fortress where Sidisi serves.

entities.name: Marang
entities.description: The region from which a caravan of tribute arrives.

entities.name: Gurmag province
entities.description: A province where the envoy's people won victories against Dromoka's fortresses.

entities.name: Jrung Orchid poison
entities.description: Poison vials made from the Jrung Orchid that the envoy uses against Silumgar.

events.summary: Sidisi recalls her death by the knife and her revival as an undead naga, which took away her ability to feel pleasure.
events.quote: as the knife plunged into her heart, and the necromancers chanted the spell that would bring her back

events.summary: A caravan from Marang arrives with tribute, and a human sent by Jhinu offers Sidisi a purse of jewels for an audience.
events.quote: Jhinu sent me," he said, handing Sidisi a small purse of gems.

events.summary: Sidisi confronts the envoy about the short tribute and warns that he must speak to her, not to the dragon.
events.quote: Do you not believe that your Lord deserves his cut?

events.summary: The envoy reveals three vials of Jrung Orchid poison and asks to approach the dragon to kill him.
events.quote: Allow me to approach the dragon, and I can end his reign.

events.summary: The envoy throws a vial at Silumgar, who is unharmed, and Silumgar's poison breath engulfs the room.
events.quote: It sailed across the room and struck Silumgar's massive body.

events.summary: Sidisi drags the dying envoy to the sibsig pit and throws him in to be devoured.
events.quote: Sidisi unceremoniously tossed the man's near-lifeless body into the pit.

events.summary: Sidisi reveals she keeps a collection of poisons in the hole where her heart was, waiting for the day to take back power and make the naga rulers.
events.quote: On that day, she would take the power the dragon had stolen from her, and the naga would become what they were always meant to be—rulers of these lands.

relations.note: She is his translator and appears loyal.
relations.quote: The dragon has made me who I am today, and I am loyal to him.

relations.note: Secretly she plans to poison him.
relations.quote: Sidisi waited for the day when their potency had matured, and for when the dragon let his guard down.

relations.note: She throws him to the sibsig pit after his failed attempt.
relations.quote: Sidisi unceremoniously tossed the man's near-lifeless body into the pit.

relations.note: Sent by Jhinu, who she says sent him to die in his place.
relations.quote: Jhinu, the one who sent you to die in his place, yes?

relations.note: He tries to poison the dragon.
relations.quote: I hold three vials of poison made from the Jrung Orchid.

relations.note: She is an undead naga who rose through the ranks of the Naga.
relations.quote: rising through the ranks of Naga in her attempts to gain power
